mentions.name: Comedot
mentions.description: An open-source framework for the Godot game engine that collects common, reusable game functionality. The author consolidates common code taken from their many (about 100) unfinished game prototypes into this framework.
mentions.problem: Common game functionality keeps getting reimplemented across many unfinished game prototypes.
mentions.source_excerpt:
..but I get to take the common stuff from each and put it into an open-source Godot framework so as to not feel totally useless :')

https://github.com/InvadingOctopus/comedot
